item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Tej. A junior at Wakeland High School, class of 2027. I study computer science and build software.

I ship things people use. I learn what each project needs as I go. Python for trading. C++ and Java for coursework and fundamentals. Lately, plenty of AI API and pipeline work.

Recent builds:

  • An AI used-car inspector. Upload photos of a car listing. Get condition flags with evidence, a price check against comparable listings, and the questions to ask the seller.
  • An automated trading system in Python. Backtest first. Paper trade second.
  • Nightwatch, a time tracker. Read the post about a Nightwatch bug to see how I debug.

Outside of code #

  • Anime. My main way to wind down.
  • Drawing. I sketch for fun.
  • Instruments. Piano, guitar, viola, and trombone.
  • The gym. My time off a screen.

Elsewhere #

Find me on GitHub or LinkedIn. Email works too.
